meta.title: Lendriti Group SHPK | Heavy Machinery Trading
meta.description: Professional European dealer of excavators, trucks and heavy machinery. Buy and sell used equipment with Lendriti Group SHPK, Mitrovicë, Kosovo.

company.intro: Lendriti Group SHPK buys and sells excavators, trucks and other heavy machinery from Mitrovicë, Kosovo. We trade with contractors and dealers who need inspected machines, clear paperwork and a direct counterpart.

home.heroTitle: Professional machinery. Clear prices. Direct from the yard.
home.heroSubtitle: Lendriti Group SHPK trades used excavators, trucks and heavy equipment for contractors across Europe.

home.trucksLead: Tractor units and heavy trucks ready for work.

home.aboutBody: We buy machines, prepare them and sell them with complete specifications. If the machine you need is not for sale, we find it for you.
home.contactBody: Call, write or send a WhatsApp message. We respond in English, Albanian and German.

about.title: About Lendriti Group SHPK
about.lead: We are a heavy-equipment trading company based in Mitrovicë. Our work is straightforward: we buy machines, inspect them, and sell them to contractors and dealers who need equipment they can put to work.
about.buy: We buy excavators, trucks and other plant from fleets and private sellers in Europe.
about.sell: We sell inspected machines from our yard with full specifications and honest condition reports.
about.source: If you need a specific machine, we source it through our network.
about.whereBody: Our yard is in Mitrovicë, Kosovo. We regularly move machines to and from the EU, the Nordics and the Western Balkans.
